blockingIssues.description: `pull --bench` is still a placeholder and does not execute the required post-download benchmark with reported metrics.
Download subprocess execution captures output, suppressing live progress updates required for pull progress visibility.
Benchmark TPS math collapses prompt_tps and gen_tps to the same value, invalidating per-metric comparison and PASS/WARN/FAIL behavior.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update command-registration guidance to match this repository's convention (`src/mlx_stack/cli/main.py`) or make the instruction repo-convention aware instead of hardcoding `cli/__init__.py`.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviewer noted mismatch between `.factory/skills/cli-feature/SKILL.md` command wiring guidance and actual command registration location in `src/mlx_stack/cli/main.py`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Enforce preflight validation that each feature `skillName` points to an invokable skill in the runtime environment before assigning worker sessions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Bench feature metadata referenced `cli-feature`, but worker transcript recorded `Skill "cli-feature" not found`, forcing ad-hoc execution outside the intended procedure.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify and enforce procedure-deviation reporting: if tests-first order is not followed, workers should mark `followedProcedure=false` with explicit deviations in handoff.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Two tooling feature transcripts show production-file creation before tests while handoff still reported strict procedure compliance.
